identity.title: [backlog][csdlc-v3] Add a simple gh-style issue creation command

values.summary: Implemented one GitHub-like C-SDLC v3 issue-create command that constructs the existing typed dispatch and preserves authority, intent, readback, receipt, and reconciliation behavior.
actual_changes: Added strict title, inline-body/body-file, repeatable label/assignee, milestone, repository, credential-name, exact-head, and execute parsing.
Projected the simple flags into OperationalRemoteDispatchRequest and the existing GithubMutation::IssueCreate path without an alternate transport.
Added positive, adversarial, and inactive-authority CLI tests while retaining assigned-number and idempotent reconciliation unit proof.
Documented the simple command first and the request-file form as the advanced audit interface.
